title: IUST_NLP at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detecting Sexism with Transformers and Task-adaptive Pretraining
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation and benchmarking of NLP classifiers for detecting sexism in social media text. While sexism is an ethical issue, the research is focused on classification performance and model architecture rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
